name: Open Book Stretch
steps: Lie on your side with your knees bent at 90 degrees and hips stacked, resting your head on a small pillow or mat.
Extend both arms straight out in front of your chest, resting your top palm directly on your bottom palm.
Keeping your knees glued together and resting on the floor, inhale and lift your top arm upward toward the ceiling.
Continue opening your top arm across to the opposite side, rotating your upper back and chest open to the ceiling like an opening book.
Follow your moving hand with your eyes, hold the stretch for two seconds, then slowly return your top arm to close the book.
coaching_cues: Keep your knees firmly together; if your top knee lifts off the bottom knee, you have rotated too far into your lower back.
The rotation should feel like it comes strictly from your ribcage and upper back.
Exhale smoothly as your arm opens wide.

sources.attribution: Mayo Clinic Thoracic Spine Mobility Guidelines
